recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-19911; any future change to the allowed MedicationStatement.status codes should wait for a final later issue such as FHIR-55338 rather than being folded into this historical binding-name fix.
issue_request: FHIR-19911 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy change request raised in STU3 for R5 asking to fix the value set binding name for MedicationStatement.status. The resolution broadened the check to bindings changed away from spreadsheet-defined value sets and specifically called out status bindings for MedicationAdministration and MedicationDispense.
initial_application: The Jira comment records application by merge commit aa42e5dcc1 on 2019-02-18. The merged child commit 9d4a0fe093 updated historical Pharmacy spreadsheet/value-set sources, including changing MedicationStatement status value set text from Medication Status Codes to MedicationStatement Status Codes and adjusting the Pharmacy status-code spreadsheet.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, and MedicationStatement are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Later Pharmacy decisions renamed MedicationUsage back to MedicationStatement (FHIR-38682) and clarified the status/adherence model (FHIR-39271); the combined branch already contains the FHIR-39271 reconciliation commit d5e940beb2. FHIR-55338 is a later unresolved escape-valve request and is not a final change to this binding-name decision. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml uses bindingName MedicationStatementStatus and valueSet http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medication-statement-status; source/medicationstatement/valueset-medication-statement-status.xml is named MedicationStatementStatusCodes with title/description MedicationStatement Status Codes. MedicationAdministration.status and MedicationDispense.status also bind to their distinct required status value sets.

related_jiras.note: Renamed MedicationUsage back to MedicationStatement and explains why current status binding names use MedicationStatement terminology.
Clarified the current MedicationStatement status/adherence model and is already represented on the combined branch by d5e940beb2.
Unresolved 2026 request about adding an escape-valve status code; not final and not part of the binding-name correction.
